scope: Review of reference capture script only; no TeX execution and no PDF visual review.

findings.details: The script fixes the exact eight-case inventory; evidence.fixture_bytes enforces each hard-coded original SHA256 before copy. It copies bytes into a fresh per-case output directory, records the copied-source hash, checks it again immediately before compile, and compares copied and canonical source hashes after each case. I independently verified all eight current source hashes match both the evidence constants and corresponding AT4_SOURCE_INTAKE.json entries.

xelatex is selected with shutil.which and its returned path is invoked directly in argv (no shell=True); argv includes -no-shell-escape, -halt-on-error, -file-line-error, and -recorder. Timeout is constrained to 1..600 seconds; timeout kills the process group and retains the console file. The script explicitly documents that no-shell-escape is not an OS sandbox.

Report captures git HEAD, executable path from PATH, executable SHA256, actual xelatex --version output, full compiler argv per case, copied/canonical source hashes, catalogue hash, recorder proof for the copied source, and hashes of retained outputs. The symlink spelling returned by shutil.which is retained for invocation; hashing follows it to executable bytes.

Both console output and original.log pass validate_xelatex_log (rejects missing-character and TeX error lines); console output separately rejects nullfont. pdffonts is audited for embedded fonts, pdfinfo enforces one page, and a rendered PNG is required.

Scope and successful statuses say EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_ONLY; overall and per-case native_gui_acceptance remain NOT_RUN, and visual_review remains REQUIRED. Nothing in this report can be interpreted as native GUI acceptance.

The script verifies the intake catalogue hash but does not programmatically cross-check each evidence fixture SHA/path against that case's files[] entry. Current values were independently confirmed identical for all eight cases; adding this cross-check would make future intake drift fail explicitly.

checks_performed: Independent SHA comparison for all eight canonical sources
